newsitem.title: USA: CompuTrac product behind, sees loss quarters.
newsitem.headline: CompuTrac product behind, sees loss quarters.

text.p: CompuTrac Inc said Thursday its Dimension product is about five months behind schedule and that it does not expect signficant revenues from the software product for the remainder of fiscal 1997.
The company said it foresees additional loss quarters before there is adequate new sales revenue from the software to offset costs.

"The company expects to generate revenue from Dimensions early in its fiscal 1998, however, coupled with the expenses to launch this new product, we expect that we will have a few more loss quarters," said Chief Financial Officer Cheri White.
Dimensions software is a Windows-based time and billing system for law firms.
On Thursday CompuTrac reported a third quarter loss of $0.02 per share on sales of $95,700, compared to a profit of $0.04 per share in the 1995 quarter.
CompuTrac shares were off 1/8 Thursday afternoon at 1-7/8.
